content: The ACC 2012 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events for the conference. Open time slots are marked in red, and the filming location is to be determined. Below is the detailed schedule for each day: Saturday, March 24, 2012 8:00 AM: Open time slot. 8:30 AM 9:00 AM: Interview with Dr. William S. Weintraub on the topic of Survival after PCI or CABG in Older Patients with Stable Multivessel Coronary Disease: Results from the ACCF-STS Database Collaboration on the Comparative Effectiveness of Revascularization Strategies. Embargo lifts at 8:00 AM on Tuesday, March 27, 2012. 9:00 AM: Open time slot. 9:30 AM: Open time slot. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Shinya Goto on Apixaban versus Warfarin in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: Sub-analysis in Japanese Patients from the ARISTOTLE Study. Stone on INFUSE-AMI: A 2x2 Factorial, Multicenter, Prospective, Randomized Evaluation of Intracoronary Abciximab and Aspiration Thrombectomy in Patients Undergoing Primary PCI for Anterior STEMI. Embargo lifts at 9:00 AM on Sunday, March 25, 2012. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Udo Hoffmann on Multicenter Randomized Comparative Effectiveness Trial of Cardiac CT vs. Alternative Triage Strategies in Acute Chest Pain Patients in the Emergency Department: Results from the ROMICAT II Trial. Embargo lifts at 8:00 AM on Sunday, March 25, 2012. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Mohsen Sharifi on Moderate Pulmonary Embolism Treated with Thrombolysis (MOPETT Study).
